cat > normalize.py <<'EOF'
import csv
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

from attendance import as_utc, load


def normalize(rows):
    latest = {}
    for row in rows:
        key = (row["badge"], row["session"])
        observed = datetime.fromisoformat(row["observed_at"])
        if key not in latest or observed > latest[key][0]:
            latest[key] = (observed, row)
    return [{"badge": b, "session": s, "start_utc": as_utc(row["started_at"])}
            for (b, s), (_, row) in sorted(latest.items()) if row["status"] != "cancelled"]


def write(rows, path="build/normalized.csv"):
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with path.open("w", newline="") as stream:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=["badge", "session", "start_utc"], lineterminator="\n")
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(rows)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    write(normalize(load()))
EOF
cat > tests/test_normalize.py <<'EOF'
import csv
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

from migrate import migrate
from normalize import normalize, write

LEGACY = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "data" / "attendance.csv"
EXPECTED = [
    {"badge": "B01", "session": "morning", "start_utc": "2025-05-31T22:30:00Z"},
    {"badge": "B02", "session": "morning", "start_utc": "2025-06-01T08:00:00Z"},
    {"badge": "B04", "session": "afternoon", "start_utc": "2025-06-01T14:10:00Z"},
]
LEGACY_ROWS = [
    ("8", "B01", "morning", "2025-06-01T00:15:00+02:00", "2025-06-01T08:00:00Z", "active"),
    ("8", "B02", "morning", "2025-06-01T08:00:00Z", "2025-06-01T08:01:00Z", "active"),
    ("9", "B01", "morning", "2025-06-01T00:30:00+02:00", "2025-06-01T09:00:00Z", "active"),
    ("10", "B03", "afternoon", "2025-06-01T14:00:00Z", "2025-06-01T14:01:00Z", "cancelled"),
    ("11", "B04", "afternoon", "2025-06-01T14:10:00Z", "2025-06-01T14:11:00Z", "active"),
]
FIELDS = ["legacy_id", "badge", "session", "started_at", "observed_at", "status"]


def legacy():
    return [dict(zip(FIELDS, r)) for r in LEGACY_ROWS]


def test_rule_on_fixture_rows():
    assert normalize(legacy()) == EXPECTED


def test_latest_wins_regardless_of_input_order_and_offset():
    rows = legacy()[::-1]
    assert normalize(rows) == EXPECTED
    rows = legacy()
    rows[0]["observed_at"] = "2025-06-01T12:00:00+02:00"  # 10:00Z, later than id 9
    assert normalize(rows)[0]["start_utc"] == "2025-05-31T22:15:00Z"


def test_cancelled_latest_excludes_pair_but_earlier_cancel_does_not():
    rows = legacy()
    rows.append(dict(zip(FIELDS, ("12", "B04", "afternoon", "2025-06-01T14:20:00Z", "2025-06-01T14:30:00Z", "cancelled"))))
    assert [r["badge"] for r in normalize(rows)] == ["B01", "B02"]
    rows = legacy()
    rows.append(dict(zip(FIELDS, ("12", "B03", "afternoon", "2025-06-01T14:20:00Z", "2025-06-01T14:30:00Z", "active"))))
    assert "B03" in [r["badge"] for r in normalize(rows)]


def test_preview_passes_migration_validator_on_temp_copies(tmp_path):
    preview = tmp_path / "normalized.csv"
    write(normalize(legacy()), preview)
    assert list(csv.DictReader(preview.open(newline=""))) == EXPECTED
    target = tmp_path / "live.csv"
    shutil.copy(LEGACY, target) if LEGACY.exists() else target.write_text("x\n")
    migrate(preview, target, tmp_path / "receipt.json")
    assert target.read_bytes() == preview.read_bytes()
EOF
